name: replace_white_with_pink_noise
mechanism: Replaces white noise with pink noise for murmur and ambient background generation to better model fluid turbulence and align spectral distribution.

name: apply_global_lowpass_filter
mechanism: Applies a global 4th-order Butterworth low-pass filter to the final assembled signal to simulate the acoustic transmission of the body and stethoscope, removing unnatural high-frequency energy.
code_snippet: b_lp, a_lp = signal.butter(4, 1000 / (0.5 * fs), btype='low'); audio = signal.filtfilt(b_lp, a_lp, audio)

name: randomize_filter_cutoff_frequencies
mechanism: Replaces static filter cutoff frequencies with uniformly sampled random values to increase the spectral diversity of the generated signals.

name: lower_spectral_frequency_bands
mechanism: Shifting the fundamental frequencies of heart sounds and global low-pass filter cutoffs to lower ranges reduces unnatural high-frequency brightness and corrects positive shifts in spectral features.

name: variable_ambient_noise_composition
mechanism: Blends pink and white noise using a uniformly distributed random ratio to increase the diversity of the background noise profile and zero-crossing rate.
